Fuel consumption: (24 litres ÷ 300 km) × 100 = 8 L/100 km.

Independent check: 300 km is three 100 km segments; 24 ÷ 3 = 8 litres per segment. Reversing the calculation, 8 × 3 = 24 litres, matching the original reading.
